api_key.description: API key for authenticating with Dependency-Track. Conflicts with username/password authentication.

endpoint.description: The URL of the Dependency-Track server (e.g., https://dtrack.example.com)

password.description: Password for authenticating with Dependency-Track. Must be used with username. Conflicts with api_key authentication.

username.description: Username for authenticating with Dependency-Track. Must be used with password. Conflicts with api_key authentication.

block.description: Terraform provider for OWASP Dependency-Track.

id.description: The ID of the ACL mapping in the format `team_uuid/project_uuid`

block.description: Manages an ACL mapping between a team and a project in Dependency-Track. ACL mappings control which teams have access to which projects when portfolio access control is enabled.

description.description: The description of the config property

group_name.description: The group name of the config property

id.description: The ID of the config property in the format `group_name/property_name`

name.description: The name of the config property

type.description: The type of the config property (BOOLEAN, INTEGER, NUMBER, STRING, ENCRYPTEDSTRING, TIMESTAMP, URL, UUID)

value.description: The value of the config property

block.description: Manages a Dependency-Track configuration property. Configuration properties are predefined in Dependency-Track and cannot be created or deleted, only updated. This resource adopts an existing configuration property into Terraform state and manages its value. When destroyed, the property is only removed from Terraform state and remains in Dependency-Track with its current value.

email.description: The email address of the user

force_password_change.description: Whether to force the user to change password on next login

fullname.description: The full name of the user

id.description: The unique identifier of the user (same as username)

password.description: The password for the user (only used during create/update)

suspended.description: Whether the user account is suspended

block.description: Manages a managed user in Dependency-Track

id.description: The username of the user

permissions.description: Set of permission names to assign to the user (e.g., BOM_UPLOAD, PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT)

user.description: The username of the managed user to manage permissions for

block.description: Manages permissions for a managed user in Dependency-Track. This resource manages the complete set of permissions assigned to a managed user. Available permissions: ACCESS_MANAGEMENT, BOM_UPLOAD, POLICY_MANAGEMENT, POLICY_VIOLATION_ANALYSIS, PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT, PROJECT_CREATION_UPLOAD, SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION, TAG_MANAGEMENT, VIEW_BADGES, VIEW_POLICY_VIOLATION, VIEW_PORTFOLIO, VIEW_VULNERABILITY, VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS, VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT.

default_publisher.description: Whether this is a default publisher (read-only, cannot be modified or deleted)

description.description: The description of the notification publisher

id.description: The ID of the notification publisher (same as UUID)

name.description: The name of the notification publisher

publisher_class.description: The fully qualified class name of the publisher implementation (e.g., org.dependencytrack.notification.publisher.WebhookPublisher)

template.description: The template content for the notification

template_mime_type.description: The MIME type of the template (e.g., application/json, text/plain)

uuid.description: The UUID of the notification publisher

block.description: Manages a notification publisher in Dependency-Track. Notification publishers are used to send notifications to external systems.

enabled.description: Whether the notification rule is enabled (defaults to true if not specified)

id.description: The ID of the notification rule (same as UUID)

log_successful_publish.description: Whether to log successful notification publishing (defaults to false if not specified)

name.description: The name of the notification rule

notification_level.description: The notification level (INFORMATIONAL, WARNING, or ERROR)

notify_children.description: Whether to notify on child projects (defaults to true if not specified)

notify_on.description: Set of notification groups to trigger on (e.g., NEW_VULNERABILITY, POLICY_VIOLATION, etc.)

projects.description: Set of project UUIDs associated with this rule (read-only, use dependencytrack_notification_rule_project to manage)

publisher.description: The UUID of the notification publisher to use

scope.description: The scope of the notification rule (PORTFOLIO or SYSTEM)

teams.description: Set of team UUIDs associated with this rule (read-only, use dependencytrack_notification_rule_team to manage)

uuid.description: The UUID of the notification rule

block.description: Manages a notification rule in Dependency-Track. Notification rules define when and how notifications are sent.

id.description: The ID of the association (format: rule/project)

project.description: The UUID of the project to associate with the rule

rule.description: The UUID of the notification rule

block.description: Associates a project with a notification rule. This is only valid for notification rules with PORTFOLIO scope.

id.description: The ID of the association (format: rule/team)

rule.description: The UUID of the notification rule

team.description: The UUID of the team to associate with the rule

block.description: Associates a team with a notification rule. **IMPORTANT**: This only works with notification rules using the EMAIL publisher (SendMailPublisher). Teams receive email notifications when the rule is triggered.

operator.description: The operator for the condition (IS, IS_NOT, MATCHES, NO_MATCH, NUMERIC_GREATER_THAN, NUMERIC_LESS_THAN, NUMERIC_EQUAL, NUMERIC_NOT_EQUAL, NUMERIC_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, NUMERIC_LESSER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, CONTAINS_ALL, CONTAINS_ANY)

subject.description: The subject of the condition (AGE, COORDINATES, CPE, LICENSE, LICENSE_GROUP, PACKAGE_URL, SEVERITY, SWID_TAGID, VERSION, COMPONENT_HASH, CWE, VULNERABILITY_ID, VERSION_DISTANCE, EPSS)

conditions.description: List of policy conditions that must be met

global.description: Whether this is a global policy. This field is read-only as the Dependency-Track API always sets it to true and does not support changing it.

id.description: The UUID of the policy (same as uuid)

include_children.description: Whether the policy applies to child projects. This field is read-only as the Dependency-Track API does not support setting it.

operator.description: The operator to use when evaluating conditions (ALL or ANY). Default: ALL

violation_state.description: The violation state (INFO, WARN, or FAIL). Default: INFO

block.description: Manages a Dependency-Track policy. Policies are used to automatically audit components based on specific criteria and trigger alerts or fail builds.

classifier.description: The classifier of the project (APPLICATION, FRAMEWORK, LIBRARY, CONTAINER, OPERATING_SYSTEM, DEVICE, FIRMWARE, FILE, PLATFORM, DEVICE_DRIVER, MACHINE_LEARNING_MODEL, DATA)

cpe.description: The Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) of the project

id.description: The UUID of the project

parent_uuid.description: The UUID of the parent project

purl.description: The Package URL (PURL) of the project

swid_tag_id.description: The SWID tag ID of the project

block.description: Manages a Dependency-Track project.

id.description: The ID of the project policy assignment in the format `policy_uuid/project_uuid`

block.description: Manages the assignment of a policy to a project in Dependency-Track. This resource creates a relationship between a project and a policy, enabling policy enforcement for that specific project.

id.description: The unique identifier of the team

block.description: Manages a team in Dependency-Track

comment.description: Comment or description for the API key (max 255 characters)

id.description: The public ID of the API key

key.description: The API key value. This is only available upon creation and cannot be retrieved later.

masked_key.description: The masked version of the API key

team.description: The UUID of the team this API key belongs to

block.description: Manages an API key for a Dependency-Track team. The actual API key value is only available upon creation and cannot be retrieved later.

id.description: The UUID of the team

permissions.description: Set of permission names to assign to the team (e.g., BOM_UPLOAD, PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT)

team.description: The UUID of the team to manage permissions for

block.description: Manages permissions for a Dependency-Track team. This resource manages the complete set of permissions assigned to a team. Available permissions: ACCESS_MANAGEMENT, BOM_UPLOAD, POLICY_MANAGEMENT, POLICY_VIOLATION_ANALYSIS, PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT, PROJECT_CREATION_UPLOAD, SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION, TAG_MANAGEMENT, VIEW_BADGES, VIEW_POLICY_VIOLATION, VIEW_PORTFOLIO, VIEW_VULNERABILITY, VULNERABILITY_ANALYSIS, VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT.

id.description: The unique identifier in the format `username/team_uuid`

block.description: Manages a user's membership in a team in Dependency-Track. This resource associates a user with a team.
